home.tagline: A UI system for teams that ship with people and agents.
home.description: FewUI is an interface company: components, design tokens, Cursor rules, and agent skills in one language. The same kit powers consistent, fast interfaces from admin panels to guest experiences.
home.aboutBody: A mature component library, runtime theming, and AI-native docs so teams build on a shared language instead of reinventing UI. Design decisions live in tokens; agents and humans follow the same rules.

aboutPoints.components: Production components for panels, forms, dialogs, and ops surfaces
aboutPoints.tokens: Runtime theming with light / dark and brand tokens
aboutPoints.agents: Cursor rules and skills so agents speak the same UI language

home.projectsDescription: Real products on FewUI Kit — proof of how the system holds up in production.
home.resttaBody: End-to-end restaurant operations: POS, admin panel, QR menus, guest sites, and billing. FewUI runs across every Restta surface — from the floor to the back office — in one visual language.

resttaFeatures.pos: Fast, touch-friendly POS and table management
resttaFeatures.web: Multi-tenant web / QR menu and site builder
resttaFeatures.ops: Roles, settings, billing, and operations panels
